fullContentHtml:
The AP ICET Result 2026 has been released on the official website cets.apsche.ap.gov.in on 16th May 2026.  The result has been released by the Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education for the candidates who took the exam on 2nd May 2026. The applicants can download their rank list from the official website by entering their Registration Number, Hall Ticket Number, and Date of Birth. Those who qualify in the exam have become eligible for the AP ICET Counselling 2026 procedure. Check here the complete details of AP ICET Results 2026. Read the article below to know all the details about AP ICET Result 2026.

AP ICET Result 2026 OUT

AP ICET Result 2026 has been released on the official website on 16th May 2026. Candidates can download the result to know their qualifying status. The Result contains the name of the candidates, their roll number, registration number, father’s name, number of marks obtained, qualifying status etc. Candidates who have qualify the examination have become eligible for the counselling round. The AP ICET Examination is held for the students who want to take admissions to MBA and MCA courses in various universities and affiliated colleges across the state of Maharashtra.

AP ICET Result 2026 PDF Download Link

The AP ICET Result 2026 PDF Download Link has been activated on the official website. Candidates can download the Result PDF through their login credentails like registration number and ICET Hall Ticket Number. The Result download link is also given below for the candidates to download the results without facing any difficulties. The Result will get downloaded in the PDF format which must be kept safely by the students as it will be needed throughout the admission procedure.

Direct Link to Download AP ICET Result 2026 PDF

AP ICET Result 2026 Release Date

AP ICET 2026 Result has been released on 16th May 2026.  Those students who have appeared for the entrance exam held on 2nd May 2026 for admission to MBA/MCA programs can check their results along with marks and ranks through the official website.

Event Date
AP ICET 2026 Exam Date 2 May 2026
Preliminary Key Release 5 May 2026
Last Date to Raise Objections 7 May 2026
AP ICET Result 2026 Date 16 May 2026

How to Check AP ICET Result 2026 Step-by-Step?

Candidates can check their AP ICET 2026 result through the official online process provided by APSCHE. Marks, ranks, and pass status will be shown by logging into the AP ICET results page.

  1. Log on to the official AP ICET website.
  2. Click on the “AP ICET Result 2026” tab.
  3. Input your registration number, hall ticket number, and date of birth.
  4. Click on the submit button.
  5. Your AP ICET 2026 result will be displayed on the screen.

Details Mentioned on AP ICET Rank Card 2026

The AP ICET Rank Card 2026 consists of various details about a candidate. Candidates should verify all their details once the scorecard is downloaded by them. Below are the details which needs to be checked:

  • Candidate’s Name
  • Hall Ticket Number
  • Registration Number
  • Category
  • Section-wise Marks
  • Total Marks Obtained
  • AP ICET Rank
  • Qualifying Status

AP ICET Rank Card 2026 Download Process

As the results are out, APSCHE has made the download option for the AP ICET rank card available through its official website. This rank card is essential for counseling and admission verification. Here are the steps to download the rankcard:

  1. Open the official AP ICET portal.
  2. Click on “Download Rank Card”.
  3. Enter login credentials.
  4. Submit the details.
  5. Download the PDF rank card.
  6. Take multiple printouts for counselling.

AP ICET Qualifying Marks 2026 (Category-wise)

General category candidates need to obtain the minimum qualifying marks set by APSCHE to qualify for counseling. But there is no minimum qualifying mark requirement for candidates in the SC/ST category.

Category Minimum Qualifying Marks
General / OBC 50 Marks out of 200 (25%)
SC / ST No Minimum Qualifying Marks

AP ICET Cut Off 2026 (Expected Colleges & Ranks)

The AP ICET 2026 cut-off will depend on the institution, category, seat availability, and difficulty level of the examination. The top MBA colleges normally have a cut-off rank that is low compared to other institutions.

Expected Rank Range Admission Chances
1 – 1000 Top MBA Colleges
1000 – 5000 Good Private Universities
5000 – 10000 Mid-Level Colleges
Above 10000 Various Private Institutions

AP ICET Score vs Rank 2026 Analysis

Here is an analysis of the score versus the rank of candidates appearing for the AP ICET exam. This will help the students to know the expected rank according to the scores obtained by them in the test.

Marks Range Expected Rank
170+ Rank Below 10
140 – 160 Rank Below 1000
100 – 120 Rank 3000 – 5000
70 – 90 Rank 10000 – 20000
Below 50 Rank Above 35000

AP ICET Counselling 2026 Dates & Procedure

The AP ICET 2026 Counselling procedure will start now. The eligible candidates should complete the process of registration, document verification, online option filling, and seat allocation. The counselling process includes:

  1. Online Registration
  2. Fee Payment
  3. Certificate Verification
  4. Web Option Entry
  5. Seat Allotment
  6. Reporting to Allotted College

Documents Required for AP ICET Counselling 2026

The AP ICET candidates should have their original copies as well as photocopies of the required documents at the time of the counselling verification process. The list of documents includes:

  • AP ICET 2026 Rank Card
  • Hall Ticket
  • Degree Marks Memo
  • SSC & Intermediate Certificates
  • Transfer Certificate
  • Aadhaar Card
  • Income Certificate (if applicable)
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  • Passport-size Photographs

AP ICET Colleges Accepting Scores 2026

AP ICET score is used for admissions into various state and private MBA / MCA Colleges of Andhra Pradesh. Students can undergo counseling according to their merit and category ranks. Popular AP ICET Participating Colleges include:

  • Andhra University
  • Sri Venkateswara University
  • JNTU Kakinada
  • Adikavi Nannaya University
  • Krishna University
  • Acharya Nagarjuna University

AP ICET Results 2026 Tie-Breaking Criteria

If two or more candidates get equal marks in the AP ICET 2026, the APSCHE uses some tie-breaker policies to finalize the ranking of the candidates.

Tie-Breaking Rules are:

  • Marks scored in Section A come first.
  • In case of a tie, then the marks secured in Section B are analyzed.
  • Older candidates have precedence.

AP ICET 2026 Minimum Rank for MBA & MCA Admission

The AP ICET minimum ranking to get into an MBA or MCA course is dependent upon the choice of college, reservation type, and vacancies available. Students ranking lower than 10000 stand to have a better chance at admission in well-respected colleges.

Rank Range Admission Possibility
Below 1000 Top Colleges
1000 – 5000 Good MBA/MCA Colleges
5000 – 15000 Moderate Admission Chances
Above 15000 Limited College Options

How to Recover AP ICET Hall Ticket Number?

In case a candidate forgets his/her AP ICET Hall Ticket Number, then he/she can retrieve it from the official APSCHE website. Check how to retrieve the hall ticket number:

Step 1: Visit the AP ICET website.

Step 2: Click “Know your Hall Ticket Number”.

Step 3: Enter Registration Number and Date of Birth.

Step 4: Submit.

Step 5: The Hall Ticket Number will be displayed on the screen.

AP ICET Result 2026 Related Queries

Question 1. What is the AP ICET Result 2026 date?

Answer: AP ICET Result 2026 has been released on 16th May 2026.

Question 2. Where to check the AP ICET 2026 result directly?

Answer: You can check AP ICET 2026 result through the official website. Check it with Registration Number, Hall Ticket Number and Date of Birth.

Question 3. How many marks are required in AP ICET 2026 exam?

Answer: The qualifying marks for AP ICET 2026 are at least 50 out of 200 for general and OBC categories while there is no qualifying mark for SC/ST students.

Question 4. Give some of the details in the AP ICET Rank Card 2026?

Answer: Some of the details in the rank card are the candidate’s name, Hall ticket number, Registration number, Category, Obtained marks, Qualification status and AP ICET Rank.

Question 5. What is after AP ICET 2026 result?

Answer: After announcing the AP ICET 2026 results, students must attend the AP ICET counselling process.
